card.name: Linking words in ancient-past descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, of, on, would, was) right after a verb or noun about ancient life, such as 'lived', 'fossil bones' or 'ago'. They appear in passages on fossils, early humans and ancient history.

modes.label: After 'lived' or 'ago'
modes.description: A preposition follows a past-tense verb or a time phrase and leads into a place or era.
modes.example: that lived<< in>> the Eocene period some 55

modes.label: Linking word in fossil or ancient-subject phrases
modes.description: 'of', 'would' or 'was' follows a noun or verb about ancestors, fossils or ancient animals.
modes.example: the animal<< would>> have lived in well-lit waters and

card.writes: It holds back words about records and recording, so the next word is less likely to be 'record'.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in text about ancient life and fossils, where the next words are not likely to be about records.
